csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using UnityEngine.UI; using System.Text; using System.Linq; using UnityEditor; public class Script { public static string Main() { var sb = new StringBuilder(); var allGos = Resources.FindObjectsOfTypeAll<GameObject>(); string[] btnNames = new string[] { "SpinButton", "DriverButton", "GolfinButton", "StraightButton" }; Color darkNavy = new Color(0f, 30f/255f, 57f/255f, 1f); foreach (var btnName in btnNames) { var go = allGos.FirstOrDefault(g => g.name == btnName && g.scene.IsValid()); if (go == null) { sb.AppendLine(btnName + ": NOT FOUND"); continue; } var iconArea = go.transform.Find("IconArea"); if (iconArea == null) { sb.AppendLine(btnName + ": no IconArea"); continue; } var existing = iconArea.GetComponent<Image>(); if (existing != null) { existing.color = darkNavy; existing.raycastTarget = false; existing.sprite = null; sb.AppendLine(btnName + ": updated existing IconArea Image"); } else { var img = iconArea.gameObject.AddComponent<Image>(); img.color = darkNavy; img.raycastTarget = false; img.sprite = null; var rt = iconArea.GetComponent<RectTransform>(); rt.anchorMin = new Vector2(0f, 0f); rt.anchorMax = new Vector2(1f, 1f); rt.offsetMin = Vector2.zero; rt.offsetMax = Vector2.zero; var iconChild = iconArea.Find("Icon"); if (iconChild != null) iconChild.SetAsLastSibling(); sb.AppendLine(btnName + ": added dark IconArea Image and moved Icon to top"); } UnityEditor.EditorUtility.SetDirty(go); } UnityEditor.SceneManagement.EditorSceneManager.MarkAllScenesDirty(); return sb.ToString(); } }
